sun_orientation.config.title: Sun Orientation
sun_orientation.config.subtitle: Choose where the sun rises. It always sets on the opposite side.
sun_orientation.config.shaders.tooltip: Rotates the sun direction that packs like Complementary and BSL compute on their own, so lighting matches the sky and shadows. The pack reloads when you press Done. Requires Iris.
sun_orientation.config.reset.tooltip: Back to the default: sunrise in the south.
sun_orientation.config.status.vanilla_di: East is the vanilla direction: the sky looks exactly like without the mod.
sun_orientation.config.status.no_iris: Vanilla sky, sunrise glow and fog follow this setting. Click or drag on the compass; hold Shift for free angles.
sun_orientation.config.status.shaders_of: Iris is installed with shaders off. The vanilla sky follows this setting, and shaders will too when enabled.
sun_orientation.config.status.shaders_on: Shader pack: %s. Sun, shadows and lighting follow this setting; the pack reloads when you press Done.
sun_orientation.config.status.shaders_un: Shader pack: %s. Sun position and shadows follow this setting; the pack's own lighting is not adapted.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.sun_orien: Choose where the sun rises: south, north, west or any angle. Rotates the vanilla sky, sunrise glow and fog and, with Iris, the sun and moon positions, shadows and the sun direction of shader packs like Complementary. Client-side only.
